evidence_summary.binding_rationale: High-resolution image loading, tiling, and coordinate bookkeeping are dataset-specific orchestration.
Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, YOLO, DETR, and related detectors are external framework implementations.
ROI refinement depends on benchmark output structure and available annotations.
NMS, Soft-NMS, WBF, and mask/box merging are standard detection post-processing choices.
Threshold and per-image limit tuning is metric-specific.
